subject: Sentinel Labs - Renewal & proposal to move to AWS Marketplace billing
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@sentinellabs.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Sentinel Labs - Renewal & proposal to move to AWS Marketplace billing

Hi Alex,

Quick note — Sentinel's current annual renewal is coming up on 2027-01-15 and we wanted to propose a path that will simplify procurement for your finance team: convert the renewal to an AWS Marketplace subscription so future invoices come through AWS (single-pane billing) and procurement can use existing AWS contracts/EA terms.

Why this helps Sentinel: 
- Consolidated billing on your AWS invoice (no separate vendor invoices)
- Faster PO turnaround for renewals and expansions
- Ability to leverage AWS committed spend discounts (if you want to pursue)
- Entitlement sync so seats/units map back to your existing account automatically

Attached is a SKU mapping spreadsheet that shows how current line items map to Marketplace SKUs. For next steps, can you loop in the procurement contact who manages Marketplace purchases (or share their email)? If it helps, we can schedule a short 30-min call with our partner ops lead to walk the team through the flow.

I copied the SKU mapping: marketplace_sku_mapping.xlsx (attached).

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0172

--
Attachment: marketplace_sku_mapping.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@sentinellabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@sentinellabs.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sentinel Labs - Renewal & proposal to move to AWS Marketplace billing

Jonas — thanks for the note and the SKU mapping. Looping in our procurement group to evaluate. A couple quick questions from procurement:

1) Will Sentinel still receive line-item detail for usage and seats on the AWS invoice? We need granular lines for our internal chargebacks.
2) Do you require a signed amendment on Redwood letterhead, or can we accept a DocuSign amendment routed through AWS Marketplace?
3) Any change to the SLA or service terms? Our legal team will want to see redlines if there are material differences.

Procurement, can you confirm the correct inbox for vendor transitions and who owns Marketplace enablement?

—Alex
Alex Turner
Head of Product | Sentinel Labs
alex.turner@sentinellabs.com

--

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@sentinellabs.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@sentinellabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-03T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sentinel Labs - Renewal & proposal to move to AWS Marketplace billing

Thanks Alex — and hi Procurement team, pleasure to e-meet. I'm looping in Marissa (Account Exec) and Priyom (Partner Ops) to help run the marketplace cutover. Answers inline: 

1) Line-item detail: Yes — when you buy through AWS Marketplace we can surface SKU-level line items back to the buyer via the AWS invoice and our entitlement sync. We'll work with your finance team to ensure the invoice lines meet your internal chargeback needs.
2) Signing flow: Most customers route an amendment through DocuSign; AWS allows the marketplace contract to be the billing vehicle. There is usually a short amendment or order form (DocuSign) that ties your existing subscription to the marketplace SKU. We can accept the DocuSign amendment.
3) Terms & SLA: No changes to service levels — we'll copy current SLA terms into the amendment. If legal needs to redline anything, we'll accept reasonable edits but ask that marketplace billing remains the invoicing mechanism.

Attachments: co-sell_guide_redwood.pdf (quick partner ops guide) — it summarizes entitlement sync, SKU mapping, and typical procurement steps.

Suggested next step: 30-min call with Procurement, Marissa, Priyom, and our AWS partner rep to confirm the PO and invoice flow. Are you available next Tue (2026-12-08) at 10:00am PT or Wed (2026-12-09) at 9:00am PT?

Cheers,
Jonas
Sr. Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: co-sell_guide_redwood.pdf (pdf)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@sentinellabs.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@sentinellabs.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-04T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sentinel Labs - Renewal & proposal to move to AWS Marketplace billing

On Thu, Dec 3, 2026 at 2:05 PM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Alex — and hi Procurement team, pleasure to e-meet. I'm looping in Marissa (Account Exec) and Priyom (Partner Ops) to help run the marketplace cutover...

Hi all — quick technical confirmation from the CS side: converting to AWS Marketplace will not interrupt your service. We will: 
- Map your existing seat counts to Marketplace SKUs via the entitlement sync (we use the AWS Marketplace Metering Service + our entitlement APIs).
- Provide a webhook-based reconciliation feed so your finance/chargeback system can import SKU lines daily.
- Support a one-time reconciliation report to validate counts for the renewal window.

If procurement has specific invoice field requirements (e.g., cost center, department codes), send a sample invoice header and we'll confirm we can populate those fields in the SKU metadata.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
